  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  MIT BLR - BTech VII Semester - End Semester Examination - Nov / Dec -2024  
  Reinforcement Learning [CSE-4028]  
  Marks: 50                                                                             Duration: 180 mins.  
  PART-A  
  Answer all the questions.  
  1)           Compare and Contrast Reinforcement Learning and Supervised Learning.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Classify the types of Reinforcement learning and explain the elements involved in  
  Reinforcement learning.                                                                   (5)  
  
  2)           Suppose that we have the following information:  
  There is 60% of chance that will rain today, 50% chance of that will rain tomorrow and  
  30% of chance that does not rain either day.  
  A)      Assuming above data find the following probabilities  
  a) The probability that it will rain today or tomorrow.                                   (5)  
  b) The probability that it will rain today and tomorrow.  
  c) The probability that it will rain today but not tomorrow.  
  d) The probability that it either will rain today or tomorrow but not both.  
  
  B)      In a presidential election, there are four candidates. Call them A, B, C, and D. Based on  
  our polling analysis, we estimate that A has a 20 percent chance of winning the election,  
  while B has a 40 percent chance of winning. What is the probability that A or B win the (3)  
  election?  
  
  C)  
  (2)  
  
  3)           You are a marketing analyst for a mobile app that offers various features to enhance user  
  experience. The app currently provides different promotional incentives to encourage  
  users to engage more with specific features. The promotions include Incentive A (free  
  A)      premium feature for one month), Incentive B (bonus points for in-app purchases),  
  Incentive C (a one-time discount on subscription), and Incentive D (access to exclusive  
  content). Each promotional incentive has an unknown effectiveness in driving user         (5)  
  engagement, and your goal is to determine which incentive results in the highest user  
  interaction. To achieve this, you decide to apply the Upper Confidence Bound (UCB)  
  algorithm to optimize which promotion to show to users. Discuss the steps involved in  
  calculating the upper confidence bounds for each incentive and the criteria for selecting  
  which incentive to show.

  4)              Explain the concept of the agent-environment interface in AI and discuss how it enables  
  an AI system to perceive, interact and adapt to its surroundings.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)         Consider a robot in a maze-navigation task. The agent robot aims to find the maze's exit  
  to earn a positive reward. Explain the agent environment perception, action, and         (5)  
  feedback for the mentioned scenario in the given question.  
  
  5)              Explain the Monte Carlo method for policy evaluation in Reinforcement Learning.  
  Describe its methodology in detail.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)         Discuss the role of Actor critic methods in reinforcement learning.                        (5)
